[SWS_CM_00079] Checks for a received signal-based serialized IEEE1722 ACF stream event message
⌈
If an ISignalIPdu qualifies for reception according to [TPS_MANI_03683] and
any of the contained ISignals in that ISignalIPdu (via the SignalBasedEven-
tElementToISignalTriggeringMapping.iSignalTriggering) has a Sig-
nalBasedEventElementToISignalTriggeringMapping, then these ISignals
shall be processed for reception.
Otherwise the received IEEE1722 ACF stream signal-based event message shall
be discarded and the incident shall be logged (if logging is enabled for the ara::com
implementation).
⌋
